title: [Master] - [Expense Management] Move missing Employee Posting Group validation to rule violation
summary: The Expense Agent now validates Employee Posting Group through rule violations instead of hard errors, allowing users to review and resolve missing posting groups gracefully without getting stuck during submission.
key_points: Moved Employee Posting Group validation from field-level hard errors to rule violation logic in Expense Rule Validation codeunit
Added automatic line-level rule re-evaluation when Employee Posting Group is updated on Expense Report Header
Exposed Employee Posting Group field on the Expense Report page
Added comprehensive test coverage for the rule violation behavior
